notes:
**Update: item tooltips, map and autopot work on Steam again, safer hotkeys**

Short version: on the Steam client the map, the item tooltips and the automatic potions were not working. They are now. Hotkeys also behave better: they only fire when Diablo is in front, and two hotkeys can no longer share a key by accident.

## Fixed

- **Steam: map, tooltips and potions.** After the latest Diablo patch the Steam client could not be read properly. The map showed nothing, item tooltips did not appear when you held Alt over an item, and the automatic potions never fired. All three work on Steam again, and the Battle.net client is unaffected.
- **Prebuff:** the Prebuff hotkey now works when you have no main window set. It uses the first Diablo window that is open.
- **Hotkeys and the map keys:** a key you give to the map, Markers or an Assist action is now checked against your other hotkeys. If it is already taken, the app says so and lets you pick **Use Here and Remove Other** or **Choose a Different Hotkey**.

## Good to know

- Hotkeys now fire only while a Diablo window is in front, so a key you press in another program is left alone. Quick Launch keys are the exception: they start Diablo, so they work from anywhere.
- **Keep centre map with items** (Map hack) only applies to the centre map. A corner map always stays on while Alt shows items.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
